title: Paul Gordan and Clebsch-Gordan: Source-Witnessed LaTeX and Translation Working Drafts
description:
Dedicated Gordan / Clebsch-Gordan working-edition record for the Modern LaTeX Editions of Mathematics Manuscripts project. This record holds source-witnessed LaTeX and English translation working drafts, scans, and audit ledgers for Gordan/Clebsch-Gordan material.

Current public surface. The current record carries the completed authorial text of Theorie der Abelschen Functionen through Gordan_Abel27_p343_355_DE_EN_20260612.zip, the recursive Abelsche final-audit/fix package Gordan_Abelsche_FinalAuditFix02_DE_EN_20260613.zip, the Latin/English De linea geodetica p001-p047 package, the theta 1863 full-audit fix06 package, and the first two Vorlesungen ueber Invariantentheorie Bd. 1 tranches Gordan_VB1_01_p001_009_DE_EN_20260613.zip and Gordan_VB1_02_p010_028_DE_EN_20260613.zip. This makes the Abelsche final-audit layer, De linea p001-p047, theta fix06, and Vorlesungen Bd.1 p001-p028 public.

Status at a glance. Earlier Abel tranches and AllPrior/AuditFix packets remain correction/provenance layers. The full Gordan article corpus register remains open, and Vorlesungen Bd.1 is only begun through source p28.

Quality note. These are package-audited, source-witnessed working drafts and source-audit packets, not certified critical editions. Scans and zoom crops control mathematical readings; OCR scaffolds are non-authoritative locator/comparison witnesses only. Verify important formulas, diagrams, notation, and theorem statements against the included source witnesses.

Corrections and collaboration. Source comparisons, LaTeX fixes, translation corrections, and reader-facing issue reports can be suggested through GitHub issues or pull requests: https://github.com/KokunoYumeto/modern-latex-manuscripts.
version: 2026-06-24 Gordan project-control and source-witnessed tranche refresh
notes: Current record carries the 2026-06-24 project-control update plus Gordan_Theta_1863_FullAudit_fix06_20260623.zip, Gordan_Abelsche_FinalAuditFix02_DE_EN_20260613.zip, Gordan_de_linea_p025_047_final_LA_EN_scans_20260613.zip, Gordan_VB1_01_p001_009_DE_EN_20260613.zip, and Gordan_VB1_02_p010_028_DE_EN_20260613.zip. Abelsche authorial text is carried through source pp.343-355 / printed pp.321-333; source pp.356-362 are blank/end/cover scan witnesses. Vorlesungen Bd.1 is public only through source p28. Working/source-witnessed drafts and source-audit packets only; OCR is a non-authoritative comparator; not a certified critical edition.
